Summary: User unable to load internal or external websites despite active Wi-Fi connection
Root_Cause: Corrupted local DNS resolver cache and misconfigured static DNS IP
Resolution_Steps: Verified gateway connectivity via ping; reset IPv4 DNS to DHCP automatic; ran ipconfig /flushdns; confirmed browser resolution

Summary: Floor 02 shared network printer showing offline and jobs stuck in queue
Root_Cause: Print Spooler service hung due to corrupted spool file
Resolution_Steps: Stopped Print Spooler service via services.msc; cleared stuck files in C:\Windows\System32\spool\PRINTERS; restarted service and printed test page

Summary: macOS user blocked from opening approved financial reporting utility
Root_Cause: macOS Gatekeeper blocked unverified third-party developer signature
Resolution_Steps: Verified software legitimacy with vendor; guided user to System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway; confirmed launch

Summary: New Investment Analyst IT onboarding setup
Resolution_Steps: Provisioned Entra ID account; assigned M365 license and MFA; configured Dell Latitude 5440 (SWM-LT-005); mapped shared drives per SOP-01
